intro: Bucharest rewards visitors with grand architecture, leafy parks, and a lively café culture. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro: four lines, frequent and cheap; use contactless card or Activ card.
Trams and buses: extensive but crowded; validate card on boarding.
Taxis: use kiosks at airport; apps like Uber and Bolt work well.
Driving: traffic heavy at rush hour; parking scarce in centre.
Walking: centre is walkable; bikes available but bike lanes limited.

parliament.name: Palace of the Parliament
parliament.price_text: ≈ RON 60 standard tour · book ahead, prices vary by tour
parliament.hours: Guided tours only, roughly daily 09:00–17:00 · check on the day
parliament.tip: Bring your passport or ID; you cannot enter without it and tours sell out.

oldtown.name: Old Town (Lipscani)
oldtown.hours: Always open · bars busiest late evening
oldtown.tip: Come in the morning for quiet streets and again at night for the bar scene.

athenaeum.name: Romanian Athenaeum
athenaeum.price_text: ≈ RON 10–20 visit when no rehearsal · concerts priced separately
athenaeum.hours: Visit hours vary with the concert schedule · check on the day
athenaeum.tip: Check the concert calendar; a cheap ticket beats a daytime peek at the hall.

stavropoleos.name: Stavropoleos Monastery
stavropoleos.hours: Roughly daily 08:00–19:00 · check on the day
stavropoleos.tip: Small and easy to miss; step into the peaceful courtyard behind the church.

carusel.name: Cărturești Carusel
carusel.price_text: Free to enter · café and books extra
carusel.hours: Roughly daily 10:00–22:00 · check on the day
carusel.tip: Go up to the top floor for the best view down the white spiral galleries.

arch.name: The Triumphal Arch
arch.tip: Best photo from across the wide boulevard; combine with nearby Herăstrău park.

arena.name: Arena Națională
arena.price_text: Match and tour prices vary · check on the day
arena.hours: Only on match days or booked stadium tours
arena.tip: Check the fixture list before you go; on non-match days there is little to see.

orasel.name: Orășelul Copiilor
orasel.price_text: Free to enter · rides cost extra
orasel.hours: Roughly daily, daytime into evening · check on the day
orasel.tip: A big free park with rides; good for families, skip if you are short on time.

sarmale.name: Sarmale (cabbage rolls)
sarmale.price_text: ≈ RON 35–60 a plate in a traditional restaurant
sarmale.hours: Served at lunch and dinner in most Romanian restaurants
sarmale.tip: Order it with mămăligă and sour cream; portions are large, share a starter.

market.name: Obor Market
market.price_text: Free to browse · produce and cheese priced by weight
market.hours: Roughly daily 07:00–18:00 · check on the day
market.tip: Come hungry for the cheese stalls and a cheap grilled lunch; bring cash.

viewpoint.name: InterContinental rooftop bar (viewpoint)
viewpoint.hours: Rooftop bar usually opens late afternoon into night · check on the day
viewpoint.tip: One drink buys the best skyline view in the city; go before sunset.

walkingtour.name: Free walking tour of the centre
walkingtour.price_text: Free · tip the guide (≈ RON 40–60 is normal)
walkingtour.hours: Usually one or two departures daily · check on the day
walkingtour.tip: Tours leave from the Old Town; book a spot online the day before.

herastrau.name: Herăstrău Park and Lake
herastrau.hours: Park always open · boat rental daytime in season
herastrau.tip: Walk the lake shore and rent a boat in summer; it is a local weekend favourite.

village.name: Dimitrie Gusti National Village Museum
village.hours: Roughly Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00 · check on the day
village.tip: An open-air museum of old Romanian houses; allow more time than you think.

cotroceni.name: Cotroceni neighbourhood walk
cotroceni.tip: Quiet leafy streets and old villas; a calm break from the busy centre.

therme.name: Therme Bucharest (spa)
therme.price_text: ≈ RON 90–150 depending on zone and time · check on the day
therme.hours: Roughly daily 09:00–22:00 · check on the day
therme.tip: It is outside the city; book a slot and allow half a day including travel.

stays.why: The old town: bars, cafés and sights on your doorstep. Noisy at weekends, so ask for a back room.
Next to the Palace of Parliament and the big boulevards. Quieter at night, good metro links.
Central and calm, near the museums and parks. Easy metro and airport bus connections.
Cheapest beds and the main train station. Handy for day trips, but a 25–30 minute walk to the old town.

food: Try the classics: sarmale (stuffed cabbage rolls), mici (grilled sausages) and ciorbă (sour soup).
Look for a 'bistro' or 'cramă' lunch menu; a two-course set lunch is often good value.
Obor market is the place for cheese, produce and cheap local snacks; go in the morning.
Vegetarian and vegan spots are growing fast in the centre; check menus before you go.
Prices vary widely. Check the bill and confirm service charges in touristy old-town places.
more_time: Swap a city day for a train to Brașov or Sinaia; check timetables and buy tickets at Gara de Nord.
Add a half-day at the open-air Village Museum (Muzeul Satului) in Herăstrău park.
Slow down in Cișmigiu or Herăstrău park with a coffee and a walk instead of another museum.
